name: mirage
text: Live tennis is working on the engine now: it lists 9 live tennis games, 5 of them matched to Novig, with 5 lines priced. The causes were three things: Challenger/ITF matches were in leagues the engine never read, live tennis rows come with no start time, and tennis was being refreshed too slowly behind big leagues. All three are fixed. Live betting is still in paper mode, so the lane shows and judges them but won't place real tennis orders until you switch it to real. Pull to refresh on the Live tab to see them.
